# Repository Initialization

Thank you for creating this new repository. To have the repository be fully completed and ready for a [release](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/about-releases), the following steps are required:

- [ ] If you haven't already done so, generate a metadata record for the Hakai Catalogue through the [Metadata Entry Form](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/hakai-metadata-entry-form/#/en/hakai)
- [ ] Update the [README.md](../../blob/main/README.md) to include the **title**, **DOI**, **citation**, **abstract**, and links to important **documentation**. 
- [ ] Populate the docs/, code/, and data/ folders.
- [ ] Populate the [data dictionary](../../blob/main/data-dictionary.csv) file in the root of the repository
- [ ] Populate the [station-log](../../blob/main/station-log.csv) file if applicable
- [ ] Download the citation.cff from the Metadata Entry Form and include its contents in the [CITATION.cff](../../blob/main/CITATION.cff)
